verdict.rationale: Vapi's docs describe Evals and Voice Test Suites, which use AI-simulated calls and mock conversations with 'automated validation' before production, giving some automated assessment capability — but this is pre-deployment testing, not the story's ask of the AI reviewing actual completed production calls to score quality, flag failures, and analyze resolution after the fact. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic post-call analysis/scoring on real production calls (e.g., success evaluation, failure flagging, resolution summaries applied to live call transcripts) and any independent corroboration of accuracy.
